meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page, terminal, and paginated-document surfaces. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift, PDF page check, deck review, blank or near-empty page, wrong page break.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页、终端和文档的视觉效果,标出异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完页面都担心显示效果
copy.tagline_en: Verify UI visuals on web, terminal, and documents via screenshot diffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change UI often and worry about visual regressions.

howto.what: 构建或修改任何界面(网页/终端/分页文档)后,Claude 会按参考图或基线截取画面并做像素/宽度比对,再派两个只读审查员分别查设计系统一致性和视觉/CJK 细节,最后给出合格或不合格的结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何界面之后,或当你说"帮我看看这个页面/终端界面看起来对不对"这类话时触发;常见触发词如"视觉检查""截图比对""UI 看着不对"等。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页,帮我做一次视觉 QA。
say.note: Claude 会截屏比对参考图并跑完整检查。

say.text: 这个终端界面边框歪了,检查一下对齐。
say.note: 会检查终端宽度和框线对齐并给出结论。

say.text: 刚生成的 PDF 有一页几乎空白,查分页。
say.note: 会把每页渲染成图并重点检查空白页。
